# SynapseKit — Full Reference for LLMs

> Async-native Python framework for building production-grade LLM applications. RAG pipelines, ReAct agents, graph workflows, and AgentFederation — with only 2 hard dependencies and no lock-in. Apache 2.0.

## Identity

- Name: SynapseKit
- Type: Open-source Python library
- Version: 1.9.1
- License: Apache 2.0
- Hard dependencies: numpy, rank-bm25
- Install: `pip install synapsekit`
- GitHub: https://github.com/SynapseKit/SynapseKit
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/synapsekit/
- Docs: https://synapsekit.github.io/synapsekit-docs/
- Website: https://synapse-kit.com
- Discord: https://discord.gg/PSuAXHRywJ

## RAG Pipeline Example

```python
from synapsekit import RAGPipeline
from synapsekit.loaders import PDFLoader
from synapsekit.llms import OpenAILLM
from synapsekit.stores import ChromaStore

llm = OpenAILLM(model="gpt-4o-mini", api_key="sk-...")
store = ChromaStore(collection="docs")
loader = PDFLoader("report.pdf")

docs = await loader.load()
await store.add(docs)

pipeline = RAGPipeline(llm=llm, store=store)
result = await pipeline.query("What changed in Q1 2025?")
print(result.answer)
```

## ReAct Agent Example

```python
from synapsekit import agent, tool
from synapsekit.llms import OpenAILLM

@tool
def get_weather(city: str) -> str:
    return f"Sunny, 22°C in {city}"

@tool
def search_web(query: str) -> str:
    return f"Results for: {query}"

llm = OpenAILLM(model="gpt-4o-mini", api_key="sk-...")
my_agent = agent(llm=llm, tools=[get_weather, search_web])
result = await my_agent.run("What's the weather in Tokyo and latest AI news?")
print(result)
```

## Graph Workflow Example

```python
from synapsekit.graph import Graph, node

@node
async def fetch_data(state):
    return {**state, "data": "..."}

@node
async def summarize(state):
    return {**state, "summary": "..."}

@node
async def classify(state):
    return {**state, "category": "..."}

graph = Graph()
graph.add_edge(fetch_data, summarize)
graph.add_edge(fetch_data, classify)  # parallel branch
result = await graph.run({"query": "Q1 report"})
```

## EvalCI Example

```python
from synapsekit.eval import eval_case, EvalDataset

@eval_case(expected="Paris")
async def test_capital_france(pipeline):
    result = await pipeline.query("What is the capital of France?")
    return result.answer

dataset = EvalDataset(cases=[test_capital_france])
report = await dataset.run(pipeline)
print(report.summary())
```

## Architecture — Six Layers

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Application Layer                      │
│  Scripts · FastAPI · Jupyter · Services │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Tools & CLI                            │
│  CLI · PromptHub · Plugins · 47+ Tools  │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Core Orchestration                     │
│  RAGPipeline · Agent · StateGraph       │
│  AgentFederation · AgentRegistry        │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Data & Memory                          │
│  53 Loaders · 11 Stores · Hybrid Search │
│  9 Memory Backends · SmartContext       │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  LLM Providers                          │
│  33 Providers · One BaseLLM Interface   │
│  Streaming · Structured Output          │
├─────────────────────────────────────────┤
│  Async Core                             │
│  numpy · rank-bm25 · async/await        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## Detailed Comparison

| Feature | SynapseKit | LangChain | LlamaIndex |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hard dependencies | 2 | 50+ | 20+ |
| Install size | ~5 MB | ~200 MB+ | ~100 MB+ |
| Async-native | Yes (default) | Partial | Partial |
| Streaming | Yes (default) | Varies | Varies |
| Cost tracking | Built-in | SaaS add-on | No |
| Evaluation / EvalCI | CLI + GitHub Action | SaaS add-on | Built-in |
| Graph workflows | Built-in | Separate package | No |
| Agent federation | Yes | No | No |
| Reasoning LLMs | Unified adapter | Manual | Manual |
| License | Apache 2.0 | MIT | MIT |
